definition_de: etwas noch einmal sagen oder machen (eine Frage wiederholen, Vokabeln wiederholen, eine Klasse wiederholen). Trennbar (wíederholen, holt wieder, hat wiedergeholt) heißt es selten 'etwas zurückholen'.
example_de: Im lauten Café hielt er die Hand ans Ohr, und die Kellnerin wiederholte ihre Frage.
example_en: In the noisy café he cupped his hand to his ear, and the waitress repeated her question.
visual_idea: Most frequent learner use 'Können Sie das wiederholen?': a guest cupping his ear in a busy café is the universal 'say that again?' gesture, and the waitress leaning in to speak again shows the repetition. Klasse wiederholen and Vokabeln wiederholen were weaker (narrower use / flashcards attract text).
image_prompt: a crowded lively Viennese-style café, a man at a small marble table cups one hand behind his ear and leans forward with a puzzled, apologetic face, a friendly waitress with a small round tray bends toward him and speaks again slowly and clearly, other guests laughing and talking at tables behind them, medium shot from the side, both faces clearly visible
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, signature, caption, blurry, extra fingers, deformed hands, cluttered background, multiple panels
video_prompt: in a busy café a man at a small table cups his hand behind his ear and leans forward with a puzzled face; the waitress bends down closer and repeats her question slowly, and he nods and smiles as he finally understands; static medium shot
